[SWS_CM_99033] Allocating data for event transfer
⌈
Data shall be requested
by calling the Allocate method of the specific Event class as defined in
[SWS_CM_90438]. By calling the Send method with the data, it is ensured that the
data will be freed by the Communication Management.
⌋
